description: The Logitech Signature Comfort Plus M850 L is a basic mouse with good ergonomics and a tiny cushion attached to it for added comfort. It’s an everyday mouse for casual users and Logitech has added a few advanced hardware features to help home, office and hybrid work users. The focus is indeed on comfort and all-day usage. But not everything is as it seems.
title: Logitech Signature Comfort Plus M850 L Review: Creature Comforts for Those Who Need It

description: In recent years, WhatsApp has become a crucial part of everyday communication. Not just in India, but globally, billions use it for keeping in touch with family, coordinating work, receiving business updates, or sharing documents. While WhatsApp natively enables end-to-end encryption for personal messages and calls, other privacy and security features can help keep your data secure. These include simple two-step verification, biometric locks, and even controls that prevent strangers from adding you to groups or repeatedly calling you.
title: Top 5 WhatsApp Privacy Settings Every Indian User Should Enable Right Now

description: Some of the best smartphones with a 120Hz refresh rate display under Rs. 20,000 include the iQOO Z11 Lite, Moto G37 Power, Realme C100x, Poco M8 5G, and CMF Phone 2 Pro. The 120Hz refresh rate enables smooth scrolling, improved gaming performance and enhanced touch responsiveness.
title: Best Smartphones With 120Hz Refresh Rate Display Under Rs 20,000 in India: iQOO Z11 Lite, Moto G37 Power, More

description: Instagram lets you add up to five external links directly to your profile, making it easier to share your website, portfolio, online store or social media pages without using a third-party link-in-bio service. You can also customise link titles and rearrange their order whenever needed. This guide explains how to add multiple links to your Instagram bio, how the links appear on your profile, and how to reorder them so your most important page is displayed first.
title: How to Add Multiple Links to Your Instagram Bio in India: A Step-By-Step Guide

description: OnePlus N6x will be launched in India on July 31 at 12 pm IST, the company recently announced. The company has also confirmed that the OnePlus N6x will be available for purchase in India via Amazon and the OnePlus India online store. Additionally, the handset will be offered in two distinct colour options, dubbed Burgundy Red and Ice Blue. The OnePlus N6x will be equipped with a 7,000mAh battery. It is confirmed to feature a single rear camera system, which will be placed inside a pill-shaped camera island.
title: OnePlus N6x Roundup: Launch Date, Expected Price and Specifications
